title: The page menu holds Audit Log, which opens the Credit Terms Log
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu holds exactly one item, "Audit Log".

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Credit Terms Log" opens, laid out like the Work Order Log: a search box, then a table with the columns Event, User, Details, Date and Time (no Line column).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R1: “The Credit Terms page header has a "⋯" page menu top right, beside "New Credit Term", with one item: "Audit Log".”
  • S12-R2: “"Audit Log" opens a window titled "Credit Terms Log" with the same layout as the Work Order Log and the Part Sale Log: a search box, then a table with the columns Event, User, Details, Date and Time, newest first.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Page "⋯" menu item | "Audit Log" | Menu item, opens the "Credit Terms Log" window”
  • S12-R3 table, header row: “Change | Event | Details”
  • S1-R2: “The page header shows the title "Credit Terms" and, top right, a primary "New Credit Term" button (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) with a "⋯" page menu beside it (Story 12: Credit Terms audit log).”
